in_marathi.name: Shekar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shekar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shekar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shikhar', which means 'Lord of the Mountains'. It is a powerful and strong name, associated with prosperity and abundance. In Hindu mythology, Shiva, the god of destruction, is often depicted as residing on the mountain Kailash. As such, the name Shekar is a tribute to the divine power and strength of the mountains.
